title: Accept test evidence for evaluation and completion by matching Git input instead of a named-root sighting
outcome: Accept test evidence for evaluation and completion by matching Git input instead of a named-root sighting
acceptance: Acceptance-evaluation admission and consumption (including completion) accept a required check when the evaluated input equals the check's recorded Git input: the same full commit for an ordinary committed run, or the exact staged tree for the staged review/gate lane (base HEAD is provenance only). Different commits are never interchangeable merely because their trees match.

The separate named-root-sighting prerequisite (require_named_root_judged_source, assess_named_root_source and the matching consumption logic) and the source-freshness/obligation barriers whose only basis is a missing or assumed sighting or the retired content scheme are replaced by this rule. Actual failed results, work/claim/root/result scope, required check kinds and non-source safeguards stay.

An input dirty before the run is not eligible; a later commit never repairs an unrecorded dirty input. Old observations, evaluations, content-v1 records, seals and frozen in-flight intents keep their recorded meaning and are read as stored, with no relabelling or fabricated history.

Tests cover ordinary committed input, staged-tree input, a mismatched commit, a dirty-before input, a failed run, an old content-v1 record, and an OFF-project evaluation that is admitted once item (A)'s evidence exists.
